image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of green moss and brown earth. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots running along its back and sides. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible on the right, showing a broad shape, while the tail extends to the left, curving slightly. The limbs are short and partially obscured by the angle and vegetation.

The moss in the immediate foreground and background has varying levels of sharpness that don't perfectly align with a single depth-of-field plane, suggesting slight generative inconsistency in the environment geometry.
